body:
On the Board, within a project's lane, a column's cards stay in view while the human scrolls down that lane, instead of scrolling off the top with the rest of the lane.

**Example:** a lane has many cards in Complete and one in In Progress. Scrolled halfway down Complete, the In Progress card is still visible, held just below the column header bar.

- The cards stay held until the bottom of their lane scrolls past, then leave with the lane, so they never cover the next lane.
- A column whose cards are taller than the visible area scrolls as it does today, so none of its cards are cut off.
- Nothing else about the board changes.
title: board: short columns stay in view while scrolling
